findings.where: banner, hero caption, example footnote, workflow footnote, section heads
findings.evidence: T-OVER-CORRECTION: the honesty fix multiplied. Four disclaimers on one short page: 'Fictional sample created by PagePatch…illustrative', 'The example below illustrates the workflow. It is not a live app.', 'This fictional example explains the proposed destination of the primary action. It is not a testimonial.', 'These capabilities come from the fictional sample brief. Confirm actual product behavior…', plus 'ILLUSTRATIVE' in both example labels and 'assumed' in the h2 'How the assumed workflow works'. The sweep caught the 'illustrative' words; the judgment is that hedging has become the page's voice.
findings.after: One disclosure in the banner; label the example once ('Example review'); h2 'How it works'
findings.why: A substitute habit (hedging) replaced the removed one (fake proof); it now crowds the content (SLP-218 self-reference).

findings.evidence: 14px ui-monospace, uppercase, 0.035em tracking above a Georgia display head. T-EYEBROW passes (it states the audience, a real fact), but T-LABEL-TRANSFORM fails: in sentence case and the body face it reads as well or better. Mono here is costume; the content is not code. With serif display + italic accent + mono caps label it is the editorial-AI kit (warm-paper family without the paper).

findings.evidence: Lede "Share a design link. Collect comments. Track approval." (three verb fragments) and h2 "One design. One clear next step." (two-fragment heading, SLP-211). The workflow list then repeats the same three verbs. Failed T-FRESH-READER: 'One design. One clear next step.' fits any product.
findings.before: "Share a design link. Collect comments. Track approval."
findings.after: One sentence: 'Send clients a link; their comments and approval stay with the design.' and drop the triplet from the list or the lede, not both
findings.why: Fragment rhythm is the over-corrected replacement for long marketing sentences; repeated three times it becomes the tic.
findings.title: Ban choppy stop-start fragments that break one idea into several sentences.
